source: CMS CMCS Informational Bulletin, Updated 2026 SSI and Spousal Impoverishment Standards (April 27, 2026); 42 U.S.C. §1396r-5 for the allowance arithmetic; 42 U.S.C. §1396p(b)(1)(C)(iii) for the partnership inflation ages
verifiedAgainstPrimarySource: 2026-09-09 — every figure read from the April 2026 bulletin's chart (the July MMMNA revision), archived under refdata-snapshots/2026/cms-ssi-spousal-impoverishment-2026/ and re-derived by the cmsSpousalImpoverishment extractor from that archive. The income cap is 3 × $994 and each housing allowance is 30% of its MMMNA, both as the bulletin itself states them, and the schema refuses a file where either relationship fails. The partnership ages are the statute's own words — 'has not attained age 61', 'has attained age 61 but has not attained age 76'.
